subsetPolicyRationale: `s.raster.raster@1` is this plugin's own self-contained print-raster document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (create-layer, delete-layer, reorder-layers, rename-layer, change-layer-visible, change-layer-opacity, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
